scope: Standalone per-grant Tor/SOCKS5 connector, typed transport configuration, private inherited-FD activation and regression tests for the existing broker/compiled adapter.
integration_status: The connector is not wired into the supervisor, host settings or runtime firewall. Operational sessions still use the original broker-to-local-Tor path. This does not establish global external SOCKS support.
environment: Native macOS ARM64 plus Debian ARM64/HVF with loopback only, no external NIC or swap; synthetic credentials and SOCKS/TLS peers.

boundaries.configuration: Explicit literal IPv4 external proxy only; no hostname/IPv6 endpoint, direct mode or environment proxy. Unknown fields, invalid endpoint and invalid authentication fail. Default transport type is Tor.
boundaries.credential_separation: Local token authenticates the connector. External mode sends configured proxy authentication only, never the local token. Tor mode sends the grant isolation identity to the fixed local entry.
boundaries.admission: Only domain-form CONNECT to api.abliteration.ai:443 is accepted, after local authentication and before proxy contact. Future tools need a separately authorized path.
boundaries.revocation: Control EOF/byte and SIGTERM tested in real processes. Library stream test verifies both TCP peers close after revoke; one absolute handshake deadline remains effective while fragments continue arriving.
boundaries.activation: Production binaries reject root, missing inherited descriptors and bad configuration; privileged controller supplies the private channel, child has UID 1000, no effective capabilities, NoNewPrivs and zero core limit.
boundaries.test_endpoints: Library tests construct private internal state with a dynamic loopback external proxy. Production Egress::new rejects such a proxy; no shipped bypass. Linux production connector also exercises the fixed Tor SOCKS endpoint with a synthetic peer.
boundaries.capture_scope: Packet counters cover the two compiled adapter cases only, not all connector tests. Full transport/firewall/DNS tracing remains an integration gate.
